description: LANA CODER scaffold knowledge base — reference implementations for project creation
usage: When a user asks to create/initialize a project, find the matching scaffold, read its files, and adapt them to the user's requirements (project name, bundle ID, etc.)

mobile.ios-swiftui: iOS app using SwiftUI lifecycle with Xcode project
mobile.ios-uikit: iOS app using UIKit with storyboard and Xcode project
mobile.android-kotlin: Android app using Kotlin and Gradle (Kotlin DSL)
mobile.android-java: Android app using Java and Gradle (Groovy DSL)
mobile.react-native: React Native app with bare workflow
mobile.macos-swiftui: macOS app using SwiftUI with Xcode project

web-frontend.astro: Astro static site with content collections
web-frontend.html-css-js: Plain HTML + CSS + JavaScript (no build tools)
web-frontend.typescript-lib: TypeScript npm library with tsup bundling

web-backend.fastapi: FastAPI async web API with Python
web-backend.spring-boot-java: Spring Boot 3 REST API with Java
web-backend.spring-boot-kotlin: Spring Boot 3 REST API with Kotlin
web-backend.go-http: Go HTTP server using net/http and gorilla/mux
web-backend.aspnet-core: ASP.NET Core 8 Web API with C#

cli.rust-clap: Rust CLI using Clap derive macros

desktop.macos-cocoa: macOS Cocoa app with AppKit (Xcode project)
